stories.h: King tide flood advisory for Seattle shoreline today
stories.s: An NWS coastal flood advisory runs 2 a.m.–5 p.m. Tuesday for Seattle and southern King lowlands, with 1.5–2.5 ft of inundation possible. Tides peak Wednesday amid gusty winds and heavy rain.

stories.h: Port of Seattle commissioners call ICE 'rogue,' order review
stories.s: After Saturday's jet-bridge arrests of a father and daughter at Sea-Tac, commissioners unanimously criticized ICE, ordered an airport badging review and backed a Senate bill limiting enforcement at airports.

stories.h: Mark Ellerbrook nominated interim CEO of homelessness authority
stories.s: Mayor Wilson and Executive Zahilay picked Seattle's human services director to lead the troubled KCRHA. Its board votes Dec. 4, and contracts return to the city and county Jan. 1 amid a $17M gap.

coming.h: Coastal flood watch as king tides peak
coming.s: NWS watches cover Seattle and southern King lowlands late Tuesday night through Wednesday afternoon (2–3 ft) and again Wednesday night into Thursday (2.5–3.5 ft).
